contexts.text: Mamre, Eshcol, and Aner represented and signified the Angels who were with the Lord when He combated in His first childhood...
Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. These names signify the goods and truths from which the combat was waged; not so much the Angels...
The names Eshcol, Aner, and Mamre represent the Angels, and therefore signify those things that the Angels have.
